problem: Production Playwright readback found data-bg-stage=loss in the DOM on a 390px viewport but could not click it because the element was not visible/stable.

evidence.failed_step: Verify pricing interactions and English route in production
evidence.observed_error: locator.click Timeout 30000ms; locator resolved to data-bg-stage=loss but waited for element to be visible, enabled and stable

root_cause: The delivery chain proved DOM presence and route rendering but did not require computed mobile visibility/clickability of pricing controls on deploy-preview. Existing mobile CSS used normal-priority visibility rules, so a later/global computed-style interaction could still collapse or hide the click target without failing pre-merge CI.
fix: Force the lifecycle pricing container, tab grid and tab buttons visible/clickable on <=900px with explicit important visibility/display/geometry guards.
Run the full pricing interaction and static English-route Playwright proof against the exact Netlify deploy-preview whenever /prijzen is affected.
prevention: Never accept DOM presence as proof of a primary mobile control; require Playwright clickability on a 390px viewport.
Pricing deploy-preview must prove lifecycle selection, Run tab selection, yearly billing price mutation and navigation to /en/prijzen before merge.
Keep production readback fail-closed and record exact browser errors as learning evidence.
